text_block_list.text: Summer training camp had finally come to an end...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...This year's training camp turned out to be truly fulfilling.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
F-Fool!
That is not what I meant!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I am grateful for that much, at least.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) will be here before we know it.
Stay focused, and don't let down your guard—
choice_data_list: I'll keep right up with you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Heh.
Seems my worries were completely unfounded.
